system.description: You summon a traditional elemental spirit-salamander (fire), sylph (air), gnome (earth) or undine (water)-while near a quantity of the corresponding element. All elementals have at least six Physical and Mental Traits, with elemental-themed powers of the Storyteller's design. You must win a Static Mental Challenge to exert control; success lets you command it by spending one Mental Trait per command, while failure may leave it indifferent or hostile. Commanding it into danger to itself requires another Mental Challenge. The elemental persists as long as it remains under your control.
